Our values

Maximize time
We believe in harnessing every moment to its fullest potential, whether it's for our team or our customers and their clients. Time efficiency drives us to continuously seek innovation in all that we do.
Customer driven
We are dedicated to understanding our customers' needs, preferences, and challenges, and we prioritize their success above all else. Customer-centricity guides our decisions, drives our actions, and shapes our products and services.
Output over effort
While effort is important, we believe that the true measure of success lies in the actual results we produce. By embracing a results-oriented approach, we foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Remain flexible
We seek to make our platform universally accessible. Nail artists, hairdressers, accountants, personal trainers, dog groomers, you name it—we build products to be unique to our customers and their business goals.
Embrace levity
We recognize that a positive and lighthearted atmosphere fosters creativity, collaboration, and overall well-being. We don’t take ourselves too seriously and seek joy in the journey as we work towards solving our customers' scheduling pain points.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Acuity Scheduling?
Acuity Scheduling is flexible scheduling software that helps businesses automate workflows, payments, and bookings. With Acuity, you can give customers the ability to book, reschedule, or cancel appointments all on their own. You can also take full control over your calendar and ensure clients book on your terms.
How do I get started with Acuity Scheduling?
Easy, just sign up for a free trial .
How is Acuity Scheduling related to Squarespace?
Acuity was acquired by Squarespace in 2019. While Acuity is part of the Squarespace suite of products, we continue to innovate and build products that help solve our customers’ scheduling challenges.
Do I need a Squarespace website to use Acuity Scheduling?
No. You can use Acuity on its own, with your Squarespace website, or with any other website provider of your choice.
Can I collect payment through Acuity Scheduling?
Yes. You can use Stripe, Square, or Paypal to accept payments from clients. Clients can pay when they book online, or you can enter payments from the admin end. To learn more and get started, visit Connecting payment processors to Acuity Scheduling
What happens when my free trial ends?
When your Acuity trial is almost over, upgrade messages will appear in your trial account. To continue using Acuity after your trial ends, you will need to purchase a paid plan. We offer three different tier plans with our Starter plan starting at $16/month with an annual subscription. If you don’t select a subscription, your Acuity trial will be canceled.

Frequently Asked Questions
FAQs
Why should I use Acuity Scheduling?
Acuity Scheduling supports businesses with scheduling all types of appointments and services. With advanced features that take the hassle out of online booking, payments, calendar management, and client communication, you get time back to do what you love and focus on your growth.
Does Acuity Scheduling offer a free trial?
Yes! When you sign up for Acuity Scheduling, you’ll be offered a free trial. When your trial ends, you won’t be charged until you choose an Acuity Scheduling plan. Visit our pricing page to learn more.
Do you offer a free plan to Acuity Scheduling?
Acuity doesn’t offer free appointment scheduling at this time, but you can use the free trial to test out our scheduling software before committing to a paid version. No credit card required.
Can I pay for my account annually? Is there a discount?
Yes. You'll even receive a discount if you switch to an annual plan of our online scheduling software. Once you start your free trial , switch to annual billing in your account settings, and you'll be all set until next year.
Are there any hidden fees?
We don’t like surprises either. Listed prices don’t include applicable taxes, but there are no unexpected fees. No set-up fees, no cancellation fees, no support fees—nada.
Can I cancel at any time?
Absolutely. It's easy to cancel your account completely. If you decide to move on, we'll stop charging you and wish you the best.
Does Acuity have a mobile app to manage appointments and workflows?
Yes! All Acuity Scheduling plans give you access to our mobile admin app to view and manage appointments on the go. Look for “Acuity Scheduling” in the Google Play Store or the Apple App Store to add it to your device. You’re able to use the app during the free trial period.
Is my data and my customers’ data safe?
Squarespace, and its affiliated products, comply with data privacy laws applicable to them, and you can find the details of how we use data in our
Privacy Policy .
Find links below to additional privacy and security resources, including information about where Squarespace stores your data.
Data privacy and Squarespace
Data privacy laws in the United States
GDPR and Squarespace
The cookies Squarespace uses
Where does Squarespace store my data?
Will my invoice be prorated if I sign up in the middle of the month?
Your billing cycle is determined by whichever date you sign up, so the date when you sign up will be the first date of your billing cycle. For example, if you sign up on the 15th of the month, your next invoice will be on the 15th of the following month.
Do you have an Enterprise offering?
If you're looking for scalable scheduling software with unlimited calendars, VIP account management, unlimited Scheduling Instances, additional APIs, and a centralized dashboard to manage them all, we have you covered.
Contact our Enterprise team to learn more.
